newsitem.title: INDIA: HDFC Bank cuts prime lending rate.
newsitem.headline: HDFC Bank cuts prime lending rate.

text.p: HDFC Bank has cut its prime lending rate to 17.5 percent per annum from 18.5 percent effective November 1, an official told Reuters on Friday.
He said the bank's maximum spread over prime rate would be 4.0 percent.

The bank's decision is in line with that of most other banks which have reduced their lending rates after the October 19 monetary policy statement of the Reserve Bank of India, which boosted liquidity and prompted interest rate cuts.
